versions.content: Compatibility of VariableDataPrototype typed by primi- tive data type of category BOOLEAN in a RPortPrototype and a SystemSig- nal to which the VariableDataPrototype is mapped by SenderReceiver- ToSignalMapping If a VariableDataPrototype typed by an Application- PrimitiveDataType of category BOOLEAN in a RPortPrototype is mapped by a SenderReceiverToSignalMapping to a SystemSignal then the following conditions shall be fulfilled by the VariableDataPrototype and the SystemSig- nal : • the dataConstr s of AutosarDataType.swDataDefProps defined on Ap- plicationDataType of the VariableDataPrototype are compatible to the dataConstr s of SystemSignal.physicalProps according to [con- str_9374]. • the compuMethod s of AutosarDataType.swDataDefProps defined on ApplicationDataType of the VariableDataPrototype is compatible to the compuMethod of SystemSignal.physicalProps according to [con- str_9371].
